text: Choose a full-height left sidebar for primary navigation and context, collapsing to a thin tab when unused. name: Lumen
text: DECISION: Use a hybrid alert system—persistent 4% top banner with pulsing indicator for critical updates, plus a tiny sidebar dot that expands to full banner on hover or new critical event. Must deliver a live prototype with usage metrics tracking missed updates. Owner: Facet.
